# Bageo v1.6.9

**Ready in 3 minutes.** Install Bageo on Windows or Mac, plug your rooted phone in once, and it starts answering your calls. We tried it ourselves.

- **One installer, one click to start, or Docker.** Windows setup or Mac dmg: plug the phone in over USB once, then it works over Wi-Fi. In Docker (`bageo/bageo-call`), type Bageo's IP address and a 6-digit code on the phone instead, no USB needed.
- **Open the console at `http://bageo.local/`** on this computer or on any phone on the same Wi-Fi, once a console password is set.
- **Forward to your phone, and choose who:** one switch, off by default, for the Whitelist, other contacts or numbers not in your contacts. When it's urgent, the AI asks the caller to hold and puts you through.
- **Calls handled to fit the situation**, with fewer calls cut off by mistake in more languages, and Italian added.
- **Automatic backups you can encrypt**, and a desktop notice when a call summary is ready.
- **Update the phone module too:** switching back to a normal phone no longer gets stuck on Do Not Disturb.

**Why 1.6.9?** This is the most complete Bageo so far: everything it should have is here, and it feels complete in real use. In Chinese, 1 (一) is the first word of 一直, "always", and 69 looks like the infinity sign ∞. Together they mean an endless beginning, a project that keeps growing for good.

## 繁體中文

**3 分鐘就能用。** 在 Windows 或 Mac 裝好 Bageo，已 root 的手機用 USB 接一次，就開始幫你接電話。我們自己實際測過。

- **一個安裝檔點一下就啟動，也能用 Docker。** Windows 安裝程式或 Mac dmg：手機用 USB 接一次，之後走 Wi-Fi。用 Docker（`bageo/bageo-call`）的話，在手機輸入 Bageo 的 IP 位址和 6 位數配對碼就好，不用 USB。
- **用 `http://bageo.local/` 打開控制台**，這台電腦或同一個 Wi-Fi 的手機都能開（先設好控制台密碼）。
- **轉接到你的手機，誰打來可以轉由你決定：** 一個開關、預設關閉，可選白名單、其他聯絡人或不在聯絡人裡的號碼。有急事時，AI 請對方稍等並把電話轉給你。
- **依情境應對每一通電話**，更多語言不會被誤掛，也加了義大利語。
- **自動備份，可以加密**；通話摘要寫好時，桌面也會通知你。
- **手機模組也要更新：** 切回一般手機不會再卡在勿擾。

**為什麼是 1.6.9？** 這是目前最完整的 Bageo：該有的都有了，實際用起來也很完整。1 是「一直」的「一」，69 像一個無限符號 ∞，合起來就是一直、無限地開始，帶著這個項目持續、永恆地發展。

Full changes / 完整變更：[CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/h4lo-void/bageo-call/blob/v1.6.9/CHANGELOG.md)
